steps.expected: App loads in light mode with theme toggle visible
steps.observed: App loaded with switch 'Switch to dark mode' [ref=e5] visible. localStorage theme=null (defaults to light)

steps.action: Click theme toggle to switch to dark mode
steps.expected: All components update to dark mode colors, toggle label changes
steps.observed: Toggle changed to 'Switch to light mode' [checked]. Background darkened, text colors updated to light variants. localStorage theme='dark'
After reload, toggle still shows 'Switch to light mode' [checked]. localStorage theme='dark'. All components rendered in dark mode.

steps.action: Navigate to /start page and locate palette selectors
steps.expected: Light and Dark palette dropdowns with 8 options each
steps.observed: Two combobox selectors found: light (8 options) and dark (8 options). All 16 palettes present.

steps.expected: 8 light: GitHub, SpaceGray, Catppuccin Latte, Nord, Rose Pine Dawn, Tokyo Day, Solarized, One Light; 8 dark: GitHub, SpaceGray, Catppuccin Mocha, Nord, Rose Pine, Tokyo Night, Monokai, Kanagawa
steps.observed: Light: GitHub Light, SpaceGray Light, Catppuccin Latte, Nord Light, Rose Pine Dawn, Tokyo Night Day, Solarized Light, One Light. Dark: GitHub Dark, SpaceGray Dark, Catppuccin Mocha, Nord Dark, Rose Pine, Tokyo Night, Monokai, Kanagawa. All 16 match.

steps.expected: Colors change to Catppuccin Latte palette, persisted to localStorage
steps.observed: localStorage lightPalette changed to 'catppuccin-latte'. Visual color change observed in screenshot.

steps.action: Switch to dark mode with Catppuccin Mocha selected
steps.expected: Dark mode applies Catppuccin Mocha colors
steps.observed: Dark mode with Catppuccin Mocha applied. localStorage darkPalette='catppuccin-mocha'.

steps.action: Select Tokyo Night dark palette and verify CSS variables
steps.expected: Colors change to Tokyo Night palette
steps.observed: Computed styles: --background=#1a1b26, --foreground=#a9b1d6, --primary=#7aa2f7. These are correct Tokyo Night colors.

assertions.title: Palette selection persists across navigation

steps.action: Select Solarized Light palette on /start page
steps.expected: Solarized Light palette applied, persisted to localStorage
steps.observed: Solarized Light selected. localStorage lightPalette='solarized'. Computed --background=#fdf6e3 (Solarized Light base).

steps.expected: Same Solarized palette active on templates page
steps.observed: localStorage lightPalette still 'solarized'. Computed --background=#fdf6e3, --primary=#268bd2 (Solarized blue). Palette consistent.

steps.expected: Same palette active on promotion page
steps.observed: /promotion redirected to /start.html?return=promotion.html (no saved profile - expected per VAL-PROMO-021). However, localStorage lightPalette remains 'solarized' and computed --background=#fdf6e3, confirming palette persistence across navigation.

assertions.notes: /promotion page redirected to profile page due to no saved profile (expected behavior per VAL-PROMO-021). Palette persistence was verified via localStorage and computed CSS variables across all reachable pages.

assertions.title: Theme transitions are smooth

steps.action: Check CSS transition properties on html and body elements
steps.expected: Transition duration > 0s for smooth theme changes
steps.observed: Computed transition-duration is '0s' on both html and body elements. Transition-property is 'all' but duration is 0s, making transitions instant.

steps.action: Check if theme-transitions.css is loaded in React app
steps.expected: Theme transition CSS should be imported
steps.observed: theme-transitions.css is only imported in legacy CSS files (styles.css, promotion-styles.css). The React app's index.css does NOT import it and has no transition rules.

steps.action: Toggle theme and observe visual behavior
steps.observed: Theme change is instant (no visible transition). Colors snap immediately between light and dark.
Video recording captured instant theme changes with no transition animation.

evidence.rootCause: The React app's index.css does not import theme-transitions.css. The legacy theme-transitions.css defines smooth 0.3s transitions on background-color, color, border-color, and box-shadow, but this file is not loaded in the React SPA.

assertions.issues: Theme transitions are not implemented in the React app. The legacy theme-transitions.css (which defines 0.3s cubic-bezier transitions for background-color, color, border-color, box-shadow) is not imported into the React app's index.css. Theme changes are instant with no visual transition.

frictions.description: /promotion page redirects to legacy start.html?return=promotion.html instead of React Router's /start route when no profile is saved. This prevented direct testing of palette persistence on the /promotion React page.
frictions.resolution: Verified palette persistence via localStorage and computed CSS variables instead. The palette was confirmed to persist in localStorage (lightPalette='solarized') even after the redirect to the legacy page.

summary: Tested 4 theme assertions: 3 passed, 1 failed (VAL-THEME-004: smooth theme transitions not implemented in React app). Light/dark toggle works correctly with localStorage persistence. All 16 palettes (8 light + 8 dark) render correctly and match the contract. Palette selection persists across navigation. Theme transitions are instant (0s duration) because theme-transitions.css is not imported into the React SPA's index.css.
